headword: {授業参観|じゅぎょうさんかん}

definitions.explanation: A day when parents and guardians visit their child's school to watch ordinary lessons from the back of the classroom; a regular event in Japanese elementary and junior high schools.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{授業参観|じゅぎょうさんかん}だ。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{授業参観|じゅぎょうさんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My mother came to watch my class on observation day.

examples.japanese: {授業参観|じゅぎょうさんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}している→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧。
examples.english: On observation day the parents stand at the back, so the children are more nervous than usual.

notes:
Often followed by a {保護者会|ほごしゃかい} (parents' meeting) with the teacher. Some schools hold it on a Saturday so that working parents can come.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {授業参観|じゅぎょうさんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to observation day
- {授業参観日|じゅぎょうさんかんび}: the observation day
- ⟦{父親|ちちおや}→父親：03469_chichioya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{授業参観|じゅぎょうさんかん}: observation day for fathers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{参観|さんかん}→参観：16172_sankan⟧: visiting to observe, the general word
- ⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧: parent or guardian, the school's word for the visitors
